confidence_notes: Medium overall. Coffee, beer, cocktail and meal anchors converge across Boston cost-of-living sites and a Toast POS beer median, read from search-result summaries rather than opened pages. Some inexpensive-meal sources include a drink, so a food-only meal may be slightly lower. The wine glass is the weakest drink anchor because no aggregated Boston by-the-glass average was found. It is set at about 1.7x the beer anchor (local beer basis) and checked against scattered $10-18 wine-bar pours. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak window, with no lodging search or listing checked, and are the least certain values. The FX date and rate come from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open that page, and this may not be the newest print by the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Restaurant and drink anchors are Boston-specific. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge judgments reflecting Boston's high July lodging demand, with no comparable-city lookup performed.
